analysis:
Reviewed the standalone (local, non-coordinator) server changes. StandaloneServer+StartupPreload.swift adds a shapeWarmup dependency to StartupPreloader, startupShapeWarmup (pre-listener warmup via bridge.runShapeWarmupBeforeServing), scheduleShapeWarmups (iterates resident slots in sorted order, one session at a time, via bridge.startShapeWarmupIfNeeded with an onRetired callback), and retryShapeWarmups, which is guarded by lifecycleState == .running and !lifecycleDraining. StandaloneServer.swift changes the kvSweepTask to capture self weakly and call retryShapeWarmups before proactiveReclaimSweep on each tick.

Security view: no new network surface, no key, attestation, or authorization changes, and no coordinator wire changes. Warmup runs locally on the resident engine and, per comments, uses excluded shapes. It does not appear to handle consumer plaintext. This is a performance and availability feature, so T-010, T-029 and T-028 are the relevant threats. The weak self capture avoids a retain cycle with the sweep task. finishShutdown cancels and joins the sweep task, and the lifecycle guard prevents new sessions while stopping. The onRetired closure also captures self weakly, so recursion is not retained.

Unverified contracts, because the EngineV2Bridge implementation of runShapeWarmupBeforeServing and startShapeWarmupIfNeeded is outside the supplied evidence: (1) warmup must not use cached or user prompt data or write to the prefix cache (T-041 SSD tier), so it must not donate synthetic prefixes under real cacheSalt scopes; (2) warmup must be preemptable by requests and must not hold the KV budget or the load gate, so it cannot starve load or eviction in StandaloneServer; (3) a warmup that runs scheduleShapeWarmups while a slot is evicting or being replaced could touch a retiring bridge, and the slots lookup is by actor-isolated key, so this looks safe within the actor but the bridge-side cancellation on retire is unseen. No concrete regression is identified. The next pass should check the bridge implementation if it is in scope.
